title: Microchip Semiconductor Package
description: Schema for Microchip package metadata extracted from the package comparison workbook and manufacturer drawing data. Numeric fields are split into nom/min/max when the source property includes those qualifiers.

ball_array_columns.description: Number of ball positions in the package width direction. JEDEC DGuide4-7F symbol ME.

ball_array_rows.description: Number of ball positions in the package length direction. JEDEC DGuide4-7F symbol MD.

ball_array_population.description: Whether the matrix is full or depopulated.

ball_depopulation_pattern.description: Description of omitted ball locations in the full MD x ME matrix. JEDEC DGuide4-7F section 4.7.4.5.

terminal_pitch_nom_mm.description: Center-to-center spacing between adjacent balls. JEDEC DGuide4-7F symbol e, or eD/eE when pitches differ.

overall_height_max_mm.description: Maximum distance from the seating plane to the highest point of the package body. JEDEC DGuide4-7F symbol A.

overall_length_max_mm.description: Maximum package body dimension parallel to the major ball-matrix axis. JEDEC DGuide4-7F symbol D.

overall_width_max_mm.description: Maximum package body dimension parallel to the minor ball-matrix axis. JEDEC DGuide4-7F symbol E.

ball_height_max_mm.description: Maximum perpendicular distance from the substrate surface to the ball apex. JEDEC DGuide4-17C section 4.17.11.

ball_diameter_max_mm.description: Maximum measured ball diameter in a plane parallel to the seating plane. JEDEC DGuide4-7F symbol b.

ball_array_length_nom_mm.description: Distance between the centerlines of the outermost ball rows along the major axis. JEDEC DGuide4-7F symbol D1.

ball_array_width_nom_mm.description: Distance between the centerlines of the outermost ball rows along the minor axis. JEDEC DGuide4-7F symbol E1.

dimensioning_standard.description: Dimensioning and tolerancing standard used by the source drawing.

source.description: Source workbook, manufacturer drawing, or URL from which the record was extracted.

bgaTerminology.description: JEDEC terminology used when interpreting BGA and LFBGA manufacturer drawings.

A.const: overall package height from the seating plane to the highest point of the package body

A1.const: vertical distance from the seating plane to the lowest point of the package body

A2.const: package body thickness excluding ball height

b.const: ball diameter measured in a plane parallel to the seating plane

b1.const: diameter of the solderable substrate surface

D.const: body dimension parallel to the major ball-matrix axis

E.const: body dimension parallel to the minor ball-matrix axis

D1.const: distance between outermost ball-row centerlines along the major axis

E1.const: distance between outermost ball-row centerlines along the minor axis

e.const: center-to-center pitch between adjacent balls when eD equals eE

eD.const: ball pitch in the major-axis direction

eE.const: ball pitch in the minor-axis direction

MD.const: number of balls in a fully populated row parallel to the major axis

ME.const: number of balls in a fully populated row parallel to the minor axis

n.const: actual number of balls, excluding depopulated locations

SD.const: distance from the centermost ball row or column to datum A

SE.const: distance from the centermost ball row or column to datum B

aaa.const: tolerance controlling package-body side profile and orientation

bbb.const: tolerance controlling top-surface parallelism to seating-plane datum C

ccc.const: unidirectional ball coplanarity profile tolerance relative to datum C

ddd.const: ball-pattern true-position tolerance relative to datums A and B

eee.const: relative ball-position tolerance within the matrix

datum_A.const: axis of the feature defined by dimension D

datum_B.const: axis of the feature defined by dimension E

datum_C.const: seating plane defined by the crowns of the supporting balls

seating_plane.const: plane defined by contact of at least three non-collinear supporting ball crowns

depopulation.const: omission of balls from a full MD x ME matrix
